assumptions.statement: Changes to security group rules occur frequently enough that the cost of regenerating the entire resource (in-line method) is a significant operational concern compared to the boilerplate overhead of separate rules.
assumptions.quote: when ever a rule is changed Terraform will re-generate the entire resource

assumptions.statement: The team is willing to accept increased boilerplate and separation between the group resource and the rule resource in exchange for granular updates.
assumptions.quote: there is greater boilerplate and separation between the group resource and the rule resource

assumptions.statement: The system does not have heavy cross-referencing of security groups that would make separate files significantly harder to follow.
assumptions.quote: Separate files may be harder to follow if there is heavy cross-referencing of security groups
